text-entry.rationale: Kerf TextField owns supported single-line and multiline text entry after HS2-CQ1TZN.

boolean-option.rationale: Kerf Checkbox owns all boolean options after HS2-SKD293.

compact-progress.rationale: Kerf ProgressRing owns the live-claim ETA indicator after HS2-SKD293.

exceptions.rationale: Pending adoption HS2-CR912H: QuickTicketComposer still renders a raw wa-dialog and sets its ::part(dialog) viewport height and pointer events and its ::part(body) padding. Kerf DialogSurface already exposes preferred width, viewport maximum, and content layout, so this is app adoption work rather than a Kerf gap; the exception goes when HS2-CR912H moves the shell to DialogSurface.

Reviewed HS2-M6B8AD: design: workspace-chat-tile__preview, workspace-chat-tile__preview-surface are the chat tile's padded preview frame and its scaled summary card, which is absolutely positioned at the frame inset and carries its own card padding, so the two insets do not compound. Pending adoption HS2-5FFT4J: Kerf ships independent-surface recognition since beta.139; the exception goes when the card declares an accepted surface boundary or a Kerf ticket owns the absolute-child case.

Reviewed HS2-M6B8AD: (extended for HS2-MGVE50) the dynamic class expression only composes this component's own app-owned base class with its `--reader` presentation modifier and forwards the composing tab panel's own root class (ticket-info-panel, ticket-timeline, ticket-code-review, ticket-attachments); no Kerf public class is chosen dynamically. Pending adoption HS2-5FFT4J: Kerf classifies literal-union class modifiers since beta.139; the exception goes when the consumer class becomes a literal union. Expressions: class={classes.join(' ')}

Reviewed HS2-M6B8AD: the dynamic class expression only composes this component's own app-owned base class with its state or variant modifier (BEM `--state`) or forwards a consumer-supplied app class; no Kerf public class is chosen dynamically. Pending adoption HS2-5FFT4J: Kerf classifies literal-union class modifiers since beta.139; the exception goes when the forwarded class becomes a literal union. Expressions: className={className}
